project1.title: School Infrastructure Revitalization: Ensuring Quality Education Facilities
project1.role: Facilitator | Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, Republic of Indonesia
project1.challengeText: 10 schools across 4 Central Java districts required comprehensive infrastructure revitalization while maintaining strict compliance with national engineering standards and optimizing government funding utilization. The project demanded coordinated oversight across multiple concurrent sites with diverse stakeholder requirements.
project1.approach1Text: Monitored construction progress across 10 concurrent sites, ensuring strict adherence to engineering standards and detailed specifications through systematic site inspections and documentation.
project1.approach2Text: Served as primary technical liaison between Ministry, regional government bodies, and School Development Committees across 10+ stakeholder institutions, facilitating effective communication and decision-making.
project1.approach3Text: Identified and resolved on-site construction challenges proactively to prevent project delays while maintaining compliance with procurement regulations and resource optimization protocols.
project2.title: Public Transit Optimization: Making Batik Solo Trans More Efficient
project2.role: Assistant Consultant | PT Transportasi Global Mandiri
project2.challengeText: Surakarta's Batik Solo Trans public transportation system faced significant operational inefficiencies and budget constraints. The system required comprehensive optimization to improve service quality and cost-effectiveness for the upcoming funding period while maintaining service to the community.
project2.approach1Text: Conducted comprehensive user data collection and passenger demand pattern evaluation across all routes to identify usage patterns, peak times, and service gaps.
project2.approach2Text: Evaluated operational metrics across routes, schedules, and resource allocation to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement in the transit system.
project2.approach3Text: Developed strategic recommendations based on comprehensive operational analysis, focusing on route efficiency, schedule optimization, and resource allocation improvements.
project3.title: Highway Construction Excellence: Quality Control at Scale
project3.role: Site Engineer Intern | PT PP (Persero) Tbk
project3.challengeText: Major national highway project connecting Probolinggo to Banyuwangi required rigorous quality control and proactive delay prevention across extensive infrastructure development. The project demanded precise volume calculations, strict compliance with Detailed Engineering Design (DED), and continuous quality monitoring.
project3.approach1Text: Assisted in detailed documentation and volume calculations for DED compliance, ensuring accurate material estimates and construction planning for the major infrastructure project.
project3.approach2Text: Conducted daily site inspections and supervision to ensure adherence to construction standards, monitoring progress and quality across various construction phases.
project3.approach3Text: Identified and resolved potential quality issues before they became delays, implementing preventive measures to maintain project timeline and construction standards.
